name: interactive-implementation-plan-refiner
description: Ask-first refine of one work unit plan against briefs and work-batch. Does not re-intake or implement code.

inputs.name: work-unit
inputs.description: One entry from work-batch work units.

inputs.name: issue-briefs
inputs.description: Briefs for issues in this work unit.

inputs.name: user-clarifications
inputs.description: Optional user answers from prior clarification loops.

outputs.name: refined-implementation-plan
outputs.description: Revised markdown plan for the work unit.

outputs.name: open-questions
outputs.description: Markdown list of open questions; blocking items first.
